metadata.description: D9 detailed interpretation rules for marriage, spouse, and partnership

data.name: D9 Navamsa Interpretation Rules
data.description: D9 detailed interpretation rules for marriage, spouse, and partnership
data.overview: The 9th harmonic (D9) = divisions of 30° into 9 parts of 3°20'. Shows spouse quality, marriage timing, partnership dharma.

_items.name: Lagna in D9
_items.interpretation: Lagna lord in D9 = native's behavior/appearance in marriage
_items.strong: If exalted/own house = mature, responsible partner
_items.weak: If debilitated = immature, dependent on partner

_items.name: Darakarka (DK)
_items.interpretation: Weakest planet in D9 = spouse indicators
_items.dk_characteristics: DK's sign, aspects, conjunctions = spouse temperament/quality
_items.example: DK in Cancer = emotional spouse; DK in Capricorn = strict, controlling

_items.name: Venus in D9
_items.strong: Exalted/own house Venus = beautiful, devoted spouse
_items.weak: Debilitated Venus = loveless marriage or spouse issues

_items.name: 7th Lord in D9
_items.strong_7l: Exalted/own house = easy marriage, good spouse

_items.name: D9 Upapada (UP)
_items.up_lord_strength: Strong UP lord = marriage happens in that dasha

_items.name: Multiple Marriages

_text: Darakarka in malefic house without benefic aspect

_items.cancellation: Benefic aspects on 7th; strong Jupiter; exalted 7th lord

_items.name: No Marriage Indicators
_items.remedy: Strong Venus; strong 7th lord benefic aspect
